p: commanded: Lest they should practice the idolatry they had learned among the Egyptians.
killeth an ox: To make a sacrifice of offering of it.
blood shall be imputed unto that: I abhor it as much as if he had killed a man as in Is 66:3.
open field: In that they were moved with foolish devotion to offer it.
devils: Meaning, whatever is not the true God, 1Co 10:10, Ps 95:5.
whoring: For idolatry is spiritual whoredom, because faith toward God is broken.
my face against that soul that: I will declare my wrath by taking vengeance on him as in Le 20:3.
eaten: Which the law permits to be eaten, because it is clean.
